jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities

• Define and monitor key product and business metrics

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search

• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

jobs.title: Assistant GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Randstad Digital is seeking a Assistant GIS Specialist for an exciting opportunity in Akron, OH. The Assistant Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Specialist supports the development, maintenance, analysis, and management of GIS data for a wide range of professional services. This role assists with GIS analysis, data development, data maintenance, and data preparation for use in GIS applications. A key responsibility of the position is providing excellent customer service by regularly communicating project status and collaborating with clients to ensure project objectives are met.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Assistant GIS Specialist delivers high-quality GIS data and services while demonstrating a strong commitment to teamwork, customer service, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.

location: Akron, Ohio

job type: Contract

salary: $25.00 - 27.72 per hour

work hours: 8am to 5pm

education: Bachelors

Responsibilities

Assist with GIS analysis, data development, data collection, and mapping for client projects while supporting both internal and external project teams.
Assist with GIS metadata creation, digital feature extraction, land survey record searches, and ownership data research from a variety of sources.
Assist with coordinate system projections and geospatial data transformations for project deliverables.
Assist in creating and updating GIS maps, map layers, and geospatial databases.
Assist with georeferencing raster and vector datasets.
Support ad-hoc analyses and provide recommendations to help achieve business goals related to quality, billability, and utilization.
Assist with quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) of GIS deliverables to ensure compliance with client and project requirements.
Utilize software applications and information from various sources (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Excel, deeds, field notes, and other project documentation) to develop GIS maps supporting field personnel and client deliverables.
Regularly communicate project status with project teams and clients to support successful project execution.
Ensure compliance with company and site safety policies.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Geomatics, Computer Science, or a closely related field.

GIS Professional (GISP) certification or an ESRI technical certification is preferred but not required.

Ability to work independently while demonstrating accuracy, reliability, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment with demonstrated critical thinking skills.

Basic proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online (AGOL), and Microsoft Office applications.

Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Demonstrated initiative and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Prior Internship And/or Related Consulting Experience Is Preferred.

Minimum GPA of 3.0 is strongly preferred.

A master's degree in a related field may be substituted for one year of experience.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

EarthCam is a global leader in webcam technology that gives construction teams real-time visibility into their jobsites—anytime, anywhere. Our solutions support project monitoring, documentation, promotion, and jobsite security across construction projects worldwide.

Our platform delivers live video, time-lapse recordings, progress tracking, and site security, powered by smart AI tools that turn visual data into useful insights for better decision-making. Since creating the first construction webcam in 1996, EarthCam has been trusted on major projects like One World Trade Center, SoFi Stadium, and the Panama Canal Expansion, and integrates with tools such as Procore, Autodesk, and Bentley.

We're a collaborative, hands-on team that builds our technology in-house and works closely across departments to solve real problems for real users.

Job Description

EarthCam is seeking a Project Coordinator to support the successful planning, scheduling, coordination, and execution of field service projects. This role serves as a key operational partner to Project Managers and Field Services teams, helping ensure projects are properly scheduled, documented, and delivered on time.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong communication with customers, vendors, field technicians, and internal teams.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to build foundational project management skills and grow within EarthCam's Field Services and Operations career path.

Responsibilities

Coordinate project scheduling activities for field installations, service calls, and maintenance projects
Support project planning and install readiness activities across assigned territories
Track project progress, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project lifecycle
Maintain accurate project documentation, records, and workflow updates
Coordinate communication between customers, field technicians, vendors, and internal departments
Assist with service scheduling, installation logistics, and project resource coordination
Monitor project timelines and proactively identify scheduling conflicts or delays
Support receivables tracking and project-related administrative activities
Prepare project reports, status updates, and documentation for internal stakeholders
Assist with process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects
Ensure project information is accurately maintained within company systems and databases
Support Project Managers with day-to-day operational and coordination activities

Requirements

Who You Are

Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Strong communicator who enjoys working with customers, vendors, and internal teams
Proactive problem solver who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities
Able to work independently while maintaining collaboration across departments
Interested in project management, operations, and field services
Committed to continuous learning and professional growth

Qualifications

1-3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, scheduling, customer support, construction administration, logistics, or a related field
Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities
Experience managing schedules, workflows, or project-related documentation
Ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, and Word
Experience working with project management, CRM, ERP, or ticketing systems is preferred
Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred but not required
Experience supporting construction, field services, technology, telecommunications, or service-based operations is a plus

Benefits

What We Offer

At EarthCam, we believe great work starts with feeling supported, valued, and inspired. We offer a competitive compensation package and a people-first environment where innovation, growth, and collaboration thrive.

Our benefits include:

Competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses
100% company-paid health insurance (single coverage)
Dental and Vision insurance
401(k) plan with generous company matching
Paid time off plus paid holidays
Complimentary breakfasts, lunches, and snacks
Team events, BBQs, and our annual company Olympics

We're proud to foster an energetic, entrepreneurial workplace where your ideas matter and your career can grow.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

EarthCam is committed to maintaining a transparent and secure recruitment process. EarthCam communicates with candidates exclusively using EarthCam email addresses and extends job offers solely by telephone. For more information about the EarthCam recruitment process and avoiding fraudulent job offers, please click here.

Previous administrative, office support, coordinator, or project management experience required

Who We Are

EarthCam is a global leader in webcam technology that gives construction teams real-time visibility into their jobsites—anytime, anywhere. Our solutions support project monitoring, documentation, promotion, and jobsite security across construction projects worldwide.

Our platform delivers live video, time-lapse recordings, progress tracking, and site security, powered by smart AI tools that turn visual data into useful insights for better decision-making. Since creating the first construction webcam in 1996, EarthCam has been trusted on major projects like One World Trade Center, SoFi Stadium, and the Panama Canal Expansion, and integrates with tools such as Procore, Autodesk, and Bentley.

We're a collaborative, hands-on team that builds our technology in-house and works closely across departments to solve real problems for real users.

Job Description

EarthCam is seeking a Project Coordinator to support the successful planning, scheduling, coordination, and execution of field service projects. This role serves as a key operational partner to Project Managers and Field Services teams, helping ensure projects are properly scheduled, documented, and delivered on time.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong communication with customers, vendors, field technicians, and internal teams.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to build foundational project management skills and grow within EarthCam's Field Services and Operations career path.

Responsibilities

Coordinate project scheduling activities for field installations, service calls, and maintenance projects

Track project progress, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project lifecycle

Coordinate communication between customers, field technicians, vendors, and internal departments
Assist with service scheduling, installation logistics, and project resource coordination

Support receivables tracking and project-related administrative activities
Prepare project reports, status updates, and documentation for internal stakeholders
Assist with process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects
Ensure project information is accurately maintained within company systems and databases
Support Project Managers with day-to-day operational and coordination activities

Who You Are

Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Strong communicator who enjoys working with customers, vendors, and internal teams
Proactive problem solver who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities
Able to work independently while maintaining collaboration across departments
